thread:
sara: Quick postmortem follow-up from the authz incident this morning. Root cause: auth-proxy KV cache served stale token-validation responses during a config rollout. Tokens flagged as expired were accepted for ~8m. We mitigated by reverting rollout and purging caches. Need owners + timelines for remediation and recurrence detection.
kevin: Ack. I'll take the audit logging enhancement. Plan: add per-request token-validation traces + structured fields so we can slice by token status. ETA 2w. I'll open the repo PR tomorrow. :+1:
maria: I'll own automated rotation detection and forced cache invalidation hooks. Proposal: webhook to invalidate caches on key rotation + a daily cron job to verify token TTLs across services. ETA 5 business days for the invalidation hook, 2w for the cron/runbook.
ahmed: I'll update the incident playbook and add an early-warning rule for repeated validation successes for expired tokens. Suggestion: new metric 'auth.expired_token_accepts' and alert at >5 in 15m. I can have draft rules in 48h.
jules: For permissions hygiene, I'll run a short audit of services using long-lived tokens and flag owners; will produce a table and owners list in 3 days. Also recommend adding a short-lived token migration plan for risky services.
security-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026: "auth-proxy stale-kv-token-accepts". Linked: SEC-2027 (audit logging), SEC-2028 (cache invalidation), SEC-2029 (playbook updates).
ops-bot: Deploy note: reverted rollout at 08:12 UTC, cache purge executed at 08:20 UTC. No further errors logged after 08:25 UTC.
sara: Consolidated action items (please ack with ETA):
- Audit logging traces (owner: kevin) -> 2w
- Cache invalidation hook + webhook (owner: maria) -> 5d
- Daily TTL verification job (owner: maria) -> 2w
- Playbook + alerting rule (owner: ahmed) -> 48h
- Permissions audit + owner list (owner: jules) -> 3d
- Run a tabletop with infra + sec to rehearse rollback + cache purge (owner: sara) -> schedule this week
kevin: Acked. I'll add a small sampling dashboard for the new traces and link to the existing token metrics.
maria: Ack. I'll post a short design doc w/ webhooks and a sample invalidation endpoint: ```POST /internal/cache/invalidate {"service":"auth-proxy","token_kid":"<kid>"}```. Will include tests.
ahmed: Ack. I'll propose the alert thresholds and add runbook steps: how to revoke keys, purge caches, and escalate.
jules: Ack. Starting owner mapping today.
sara: Good. Two additional notes: 1) we should treat this as a recurring-pattern candidate — add it to monthly incident trend review. 2) For Dedicated/private deployments, include a playbook snippet since customer-managed caches might need customer coordination.
kevin: Agree on trend review. Also logging: let's keep traces minimal payload (kid + validation_result + latency) to avoid PII.
maria: Will ensure webhook auth and HMAC signature on invalidate endpoint.
sara: I'll run the tabletop Friday 15:00 UTC — invite infra, sec, and product ops. If anyone can't make it DM me.
security-bot: SEC-2026 status updated: in-progress, linked PRs: none yet.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly incident-pattern digest will include this item for the next 3 months.
sara: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a single Trello board with the tickets and owners. If you finish early pls update the tickets. :thumbsup:
